title: Closest Prime Numbers in Range
summary: For two positive integers left and right, identify the prime numbers num1 and num2 within the range such that left <= num1 < num2 <= right, where num2 - num1 is the smallest difference among all valid pairs.
statement: For two positive integers left and right, identify the prime numbers num1 and num2 within the range such that left <= num1 < num2 <= right, where num2 - num1 is the smallest difference among all valid pairs. Return the pair [num1, num2] in ascending order. If no such primes exist, return [-1, -1].
constraints: Find two primes left <= first < second <= right with minimum difference.
If several pairs tie, return the pair with the smaller first prime.
Return [-1,-1] when the interval contains fewer than two primes.
hints: Generate primality information once for every number through right.
The Sieve of Eratosthenes marks multiples beginning at each prime's square.
Scan primes inside the interval and compare each consecutive pair with the best gap.
A minimum-gap prime pair must be consecutive in sorted prime order, and strict improvement preserves the earliest tied pair.
